summary: This Apache configuration file blocks access to all files except image files with specific extensions (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .svg, .ico). The actual denial rules are commented out, showing examples for both older Apache 2.2 syntax and newer Apache 2.4 syntax.

explanations.3: FilesMatch uses a regular expression to identify which files this rule applies to. The negative lookbehind pattern (?<!...) means 'match files that do NOT end with any of these image extensions', so only non-image files would be affected.
